definition: Pretreatment breast cancer (40 TNBC + 40 hormone-dependent cases) versus 40 healthy women, Senegal; clinically diagnosed case-control classification, not population screening.
gate_status: Research input contract; optional imputation and empirical support warnings; not clinically validated
evidence_limitations: Retrospective source-cohort classification; test set previously inspected; no population screening calibration, prospective or incident-risk validation.
Pretreatment adult Senegalese women: diagnosed cases versus healthy controls. No external validation or paired combined CBC/metabolic-panel evidence.
essential_rationale: Require total WBC and platelets as routine CBC anchors. Differential counts/ratios are optional because QC masks them during both fitting and inference; invalid counts remain withheld.
outcome_label: Pretreatment source-cohort breast cancer versus healthy control (Senegal)
